name: book-safari-tours
description: Plan and book African safaris. Connects an AI assistant to Book Safari Tours (booksafaritours.com).

interface.longDescription:
Plan and book African safaris by chatting with Book Safari Tours, a safari operator based in Nairobi, Kenya. Kenya safaris are available now, with Tanzania, Uganda and Rwanda arranged on request.

Ask your AI assistant to:
- Find safaris that match your travel dates, trip length, group size and interests
- Show day-by-day itineraries, accommodation and what each safari includes and excludes
- Describe destinations such as the Masai Mara, Amboseli, Samburu, Tsavo and Diani Beach, including weather and wildlife by month
- Answer questions on Kenya entry requirements, health, packing and travelling with children
- Send an enquiry to our team, who reply by email
- Request a booking for a chosen safari and date; our team confirms availability and replies by email with next steps
- Sign up for email updates from Book Safari Tours, with the option to unsubscribe at any time

Example requests:
"Find a 7-day Kenya family safari in August for 2 adults and 2 children."
"Request a booking for the 4-Day Masai Mara Safari for 2 people starting 12 July."
"Ask the team if Zanzibar can be added after my safari."

Privacy and safety:
This app reads public information from booksafaritours.com and cannot change the website or see other customers' details. Enquiries, booking requests and email sign-ups share only the details you provide, such as name, email, travel dates and number of travellers, with Book Safari Tours. Messages go only to our team. No payment is taken in the chat, and nothing is booked until our team confirms it with you by email. See our privacy policy for details.
